summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ERP Accounting Fix #6: Paid Invoice Delete Reversal. All core functionality working correctly - paid invoices are deleted with proper payment reversal (no hard-delete), maintaining ledger consistency with no orphan/negative balances.

minor_issues.impact: Not related to the paid invoice delete fix, but indicates historical data inconsistency
minor_issues.note: This is a pre-existing issue in the demo data, not caused by the fix being tested

passed_tests: Admin login successful
TEST 1: PAID INVOICE DELETE REVERSES PAYMENT - All 23 sub-tests passed
- Invoice created with status=paid and journal_id
- Receipt JE posted correctly (DR Bank / CR Income)
- Receipt JE has 2 balanced lines
- DELETE /invoices/{id} returns 200 with ok:true, payment_reversed:true
- Invoice deleted (GET returns 404)
- Original receipt JE still exists (not hard-deleted)
- Original receipt JE marked reversed:true with reversal_je_id
- Reversing JE exists with flipped debits/credits
- Trial balance remains balanced after deletion
- Net account balances (Bank, Income) return to pre-invoice values
TEST 2: UNPAID/DRAFT INVOICE DELETE UNAFFECTED - All 7 sub-tests passed
- Invoice created with status=sent, no journal_id
- DELETE returns 200 with ok:true, payment_reversed:false
- Invoice deleted, no JE created or reversed
TEST 3: IDEMPOTENT / NO DOUBLE REVERSAL - All 9 sub-tests passed
- Paid invoice created, status changed paid->sent (reverses receipt)
- DELETE after reversal returns 200, no crash
- payment_reversed=false (already reversed)
- No duplicate reversal created
- Trial balance remains balanced
TEST 4: LEDGER/RECEIVABLE CONSISTENCY - 2/3 sub-tests passed
- Trial balance is balanced (debit == credit)
- P&L net profit calculation is correct

details: When a paid invoice is deleted, the linked receipt JE is properly reversed via a balanced reversing entry
Original JE is marked reversed:true (not hard-deleted) with reversal_je_id pointing to the reversing JE
Reversing JE has source='invoice_payment_reversal' and flipped debits/credits
Trial balance stays balanced throughout the process
Net account balances return to pre-invoice values (no orphan/negative balance)
Idempotent - no double reversal when invoice already reversed
Unpaid invoices delete without JE reversal (payment_reversed:false)
No new negative balances introduced by the fix
Pre-existing negative Cash balance (-55611.0) is unrelated to this fix
